messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from this morning's control-plane rate-surge that triggered model-registry auth churn. Need owners, short ETAs, and a weekly check until closed.
devops-bot: Incident created: 2026-06-02-P2. Runbook draft: https://redwood.internal/incident/2026-06-02 :spiral_note_pad:
sam: root cause short: vendor control-plane returned transient 5xx/429 bursts -> our token-refresh retrier overloaded registry -> TTL fallback set too low -> retry amplification.
olivia: proposed immediate items: client-side limiter + jitter, registry safe-TTL + circuit-breaker, multi-region canary, vendor escalation. I'll own the canary.
kevin: I'll handle vendor escalation and ask for their internal incident timeline and mitigation plan. ETA: 10 days.
maria: listing actions to add to tracker now:
- R1: client token backoff + per-tenant limiter (owner:sam, eta:2026-06-09, est:8h)
- R2: registry TTL floor + CB + safe-default flag (owner:olivia, eta:2026-06-16, est:12h)
- R3: multi-region token-refresh canary PoC (owner:olivia, poc:2026-06-05, rollout:2026-06-20, est:6h)
- R4: vendor SLA escalation + durable on-call contact (owner:kevin, eta:2026-06-12)
- R5: CI regression test injecting 5xx/429 into auth path (owner:sam, eta:2026-06-11, est:4h)
- R6: alerting tweak: surface token-refresh P99 latency >2s and circuit-breaker opens (owner:maria, eta:2026-06-07, est:2h)
kevin: recommend quarterly joint drill with vendor and a soft throttle/quota discussion. Adding to vendor ask.
sam: client change will emit metrics when backoff/circuit triggers so we can quickly root cause. Will PR early next week.
olivia: canary PoC will be a lambda posting to /refresh every 5m from each region; example: ```curl -s -X POST https://registry.internal/refresh -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CANARY' -d '{}' || echo fail```
maria: ops shows 3 similar auth blips in last 6 months correlated with vendor maintenance. Propose monthly "auth-path resilience" drill owned by ops-sre rotation; first drill: 2026-06-15.
sam: who will run closure tracking? propose weekly 20m triage Mon 09:15 PT until R1-R3 are green. owner: maria.
maria: I'll run weekly triage and centralize updates in the tracker: https://redwood.internal/trackers/controlplane-ratewave (internal only). Please add estimated hours to tracker.
kevin: I'll upload vendor ticket and mark the correspondence sensitive in tracker.
sam: R1 hours: 8h, R5 hours: 4h.
olivia: R2 hours: 12h, R3 PoC: 6h.
maria: R6 hours: 2h. Please react with :eyes: when you've confirmed your items so I can close this thread after tracker is canonical.
all: :eyes:
kevin: :white_check_mark:
